verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint that reaches multiple providers through a single URL. Switching providers only requires changing the model and apiKey parameters, and the supported providers include Workers AI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Replicate and more. A universal endpoint with cross-provider fallbacks reinforces this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the unified API behaves consistently across providers.
